name: 32233 · Atlantic Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 32233 (Atlantic Bch) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32233 (Atlantic Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32233 (Atlantic Bch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
